title: Explicit separately configured live mode/records/secrets/plan provisioning and acceptance
laws: Fail closed: only the exact string 'live' selects live; every absent/empty/unknown value resolves to test (byte-identical prior behavior).
Separate records: per-mode collections, per-account document id (test|live), invoice prefix (VTEST|V) and catalog version; the namespaces never alias.
Double opt-in: live charges require BILLING_MODE=live AND BILLING_LIVE_ENABLED=true; live without the opt-in is a typed 503 with zero provider calls.
Separate secrets and plans: rzp_test_* in test and rzp_live_* in live (both mismatch directions refused); planId() appends _LIVE in live mode so a live charge never names a test plan.
Startup/scaling provision nothing: onModuleInit, catalog() and account read make zero provider calls; a missing live plan is a typed 503, never an invented plan.
Retained UID, no converted history: the same UID holds two disjoint histories; a live account inherits no test subscription or invoice and a test invoice is unreadable through the live receipt path.
No invented legal fields: live invoices keep legalTaxInvoice=false and totals.tax=null; the mode is recorded in the document and drives the frontend badge/notice/provider line.

gates.result: exit 0 (roots separation, 3842-file import baseline + 10 patches, qa:continuity, qa:motion, qa:taps, surface audit, build)
line-coordinate drift only; 67 routes / 55 endpoints / 1656 controls unchanged

defectsFoundAndFixed.finding: An initial live plan id containing underscores was correctly rejected by the product's own /^plan_[A-Za-z0-9]+$/ contract. The product was right; the fixture was corrected.

ConfigService.set() writes through to process.env and an empty internal value falls back to it, so blanking a plan id leaked into later fixtures. Teardown now deletes the variable and asserts no environment residue.
The stub repository implemented only the pre-split literal surface, so mode-scoped reads failed with an untyped TypeError. Replaced with a real BillingRepository over the fixture database.
planId() read the same variable in both modes, so live would have reused test plan ids. Now appends _LIVE in live mode.

externalGatesNotClaimed: Real live-merchant money acceptance: actual rzp_live_* keys, approved live merchant, seller/tax invoice data and provider live-plan provisioning. No live credentials exist on this host; live keys are prohibited in the harness.
Hosted ingress and registered webhooks (BILL-01/02): canonical HTTPS origin, real signed provider delivery, second device.
Reviewed seller/tax/refund/commercial policy (BILL-06): this change invents no legal field.
